@copilot Update this existing PR directly to add the agreed opt-in ASCII-only prefix extraction to the shared Redis utility.

Add public static @Nullable String extractAscii(@Nullable String serverErrorLine) to the existing internal RedisErrorPrefix class in instrumentation-api-incubator/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/api/incubator/semconv/db/internal/RedisErrorPrefix.java. Reuse extract(String) to select the first nonempty ASCII-space-delimited token, then return that token unchanged only if every character is at most U+007F; otherwise return null. Check only the extracted prefix, not error details. For example, WRONGTYPE followed by an ASCII space and Unicode details must still return WRONGTYPE, while a non-ASCII prefix must return null for the caller's normal exception-class fallback.

Keep extract(String) behavior unchanged: only ASCII space separates tokens, leading ASCII spaces are skipped, null/empty/ASCII-space-only input returns null, and Unicode, case, punctuation, tabs, bare CR/LF characters and unrestricted token lengths remain literal. ASCII extraction is an explicit caller policy for unreliable legacy decoding, not a new Redis syntax restriction. It must likewise preserve ASCII case/punctuation/tabs/CR/LF and impose no length limit. Do not normalize or repair decoded text, parse arbitrary throwable messages, or handle RESP framing. Caller-specific server provenance, exception guards and fallback ownership remain outside this utility.

Extend the existing RedisErrorPrefixTest with focused coverage for extractAscii: ordinary ASCII preservation, non-ASCII prefix rejection including after leading ASCII spaces, an ASCII prefix with non-ASCII details, the U+007F/U+0080 boundary, and null/empty/space-only input. Reuse the shared lexical cases only where it keeps the assertions clear; do not duplicate a second full lexical matrix or derive expected results using production-like parsing helpers. Preserve every existing test and this PR's five distinct CR/LF/CRLF/leading-NBSP cases. Keep expected values literal and directly in assertions or existing argument sets.

This shared API will later replace the identical checks in Lettuce 4.0/5.0 on PR20778 and Jedis 2/3/4+ on PR20792. Those callers currently have real decoder/provenance/completion regressions that must remain. They are separate coordinator-owned deliverables: do not modify their branches, attempt their adoption here, dispatch other tasks, stack/retarget PRs, or independently duplicate this new API into them. Rediscala, Redisson, Vert.x and manual-library Lettuce 5.1 keep Unicode-preserving extract(String) or their existing bounded byte path unless a concrete caller requirement separately changes.

Keep this PR open as a draft against main on its existing head branch. Do not create a new PR as a workaround or merge anything. Do not post comments, replies or reviews, resolve threads, or change the title/description; the coordinator owns metadata. Add no configuration, module, dependency, generic utility class, boolean option, ByteBuffer overload or unrelated refactoring. The class is explicitly internal and unsupported; no public-API migration or hand-written normal-change changelog entry is requested.

Use the repository-required JDK and normal caches. Run :instrumentation-api-incubator:spotlessApply directly before the narrow RedisErrorPrefixTest validation, then relevant affected module checks when feasible. Do not run clean, force reruns or disable caches. Report exact commands/results and concrete blockers rather than claiming unrun checks passed. This assignment is only the shared helper and its focused central tests; preserve current client behavior.
